sourceChecks.text: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: イスラエルに王が立つ前にエドムで治めた王の一人として、ベオルの子ベラが記されます。

sourceChecks.text: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 同一候補名の本文出現を前後の系譜・一覧文脈と照合した。
